name: Nimrooye Piaz Dagh (Persian Caramelized Onion Eggs)
desc: Eggs cooked over deeply browned, crisp-edged onions seasoned with turmeric and cumin.

source.title: Piaz Dagh with Eggs
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 1 large yellow onion, halved and thinly sliced
1 pinch kosher salt, plus more for the eggs

steps: Heat the oil in a 10-inch skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and a pinch of salt.
Cook, stirring every few minutes and lowering the heat if the edges scorch, until the onions are soft and turning golden, about 15 minutes.
Sprinkle in the turmeric, stir well and keep cooking 15 to 20 minutes more, until the onions are deep golden brown with crisp, frilly edges. Season with the cumin and pepper.
Spread the onions evenly and crack the eggs directly on top. Season the eggs with a little salt.
Cook over medium-low heat until the whites are set and the yolks are jammy, 3 to 5 minutes; cover the pan for the last minute if the tops are slow to set. Serve straight from the pan.
tips: Piaz dagh goes on almost anything: rice, kebabs, eggs.
Don't rush the onions. The deep browning is the whole dish.

references.title: The Persian Way to Make an Omelet 10x Better
references.usedFor: creator's method: medium heat, turmeric halfway through, cumin and pepper, eggs cracked over the onions
